text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm so... out of breath... But...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I beat Tamamo! Cough, cough!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hey, quit tryna kill yourself! C'mon, take
deep
breaths!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Sorry, Tamamo. And thanks.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Something the matter?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It always bugged me.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Ya started competin' before me, and
meanwhile, I
was just wastin' away.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Then, when I finally got strong enough
to actually
contend with ya...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Ya went 'n lost your fightin' spirit. Ya
had no
spark anymore.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I dunno if it was 'cause of everyone
watchin' ya or
whatever, but lettin'
somethin' so stupid get to
ya...
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
And seein' ya mope around like dat, it
really
pissed me off!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Tamamo...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But you've changed. At the Tenno Sho,
and again
today, I could tell you were
serious. Way more
than you were before.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Now... you're not so bad.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
So, did ya decide on your next race? If
not, come
to the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Огури Кэп's competin' too.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Огури Кэп, the Beast...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's a generation younger than
us, but you
wouldn't think it! She doesn't
play around!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
She set a record this year at Tokyo
Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Her time was even faster than the
Yasuda Kinen
record. And that's on the
same track, over the
same 1,600 meters.
Ya know what that means?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
She's better than the seniors competing
in G1
races...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Since you're tryna get serious, she's a
good racer
to challenge. Besides, I gotta
settle the score with
you after today.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
I'll beat ya and Oguri at the same time.
So ya
better enter, City!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: And another thing.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Sayin' ya "just wanna run" like some
dumb kid?
That's you through an'
through. Don't ever
change.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tamamo...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Upon returning, Голд Сити tells me she
wants to
compete in the Japan Cup. It'll
be her chance to
put the culmination of
all her hard work on
display!
